name: refresh
description: Vite, React, Node, Express, TypeScript, SSL, and Docker

scripts.test: concurrently "npm test --prefix client" "npm test --prefix server" "npm test --prefix infra"
scripts.test:changed: concurrently "npm run test:changed --prefix client" "npm run test:changed --prefix server" "npm run test:changed --prefix infra"
scripts.test:staged: concurrently "cd client && git diff --cached --name-only | grep '^client/' | sed 's|^client/||' | xargs npx vitest related --run" "cd server && git diff --cached --name-only | grep '^server/' | sed 's|^server/||' | xargs npx vitest related --run"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently "npm run test:coverage --prefix client" "npm run test:coverage --prefix server" "npm run test:infra"
